name: PhotoSwipe Inline
project_description:
How it works 
 
 There is PhotoSwipe module. Well you know. If you want to open your inline images (inserted via CKEditor for example) in PhotoSwipe, you need to MANUALLY add some HTML tags and CSS classes 
 This module adds a text filter which makes this automatically. Just insert images any way 
 Now your images are opening in PhotoSwipe 
 
 Is it working with CKEditor? 
 Yes! Just insert images to CKEditor any way

 How to enable this text filter? 
 If you are a newbie in Drupal, see official docs
